title: Subnets
description: Local networks of sites (offices/data centers behind a VPN client with the "Site" category) that should be accessible to other mesh participants without NAT. Used in the Mesh section to check for address overlaps and routing.

columns.cidrTip: Address range of the site's local network (e.g. 192.168.10.0/24) that should be visible to other mesh participants through this site's VPN gateway
columns.label: Label

natMode.notCapableTip: No known route to this subnet (manually added) -- NAT mode unavailable
natMode.toPassthroughWarning: Both routers must have their own manually-configured route back to each other's subnet. Protean cannot configure a router's own device -- this is entirely the operator's responsibility.
natMode.toMasqueradeWarning: The far router will see this traffic as coming from this server's own address, not the real source subnet -- true source IPs will be hidden from that end. No route back is needed on that router, though.
